answer.approach: Build dark-mode landing page as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: dark:, bg-, text-, @theme, <main.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
